objects.summary: July 26 deployment guide correctly retracts S5-OV/ML lookahead artifacts and records useful causality lessons, but simultaneously labels Phase D production-ready and prescribes paper/live deployment with 10% AUM after six months. Later forensic evidence supersedes this promotion. Strong example of real bug correction followed by an authority/evidence overclaim.

Unified Fast Rail state after parallel work: dataset-level trial budgets, power-before-test, forward-only reopening for consumed history, negative-result preservation and checkpoint hooks. It explicitly concludes the bottleneck is test power, not number of experiments, and that two builders on one dataset burned historical evidence.

Variant of unified Fast Rail keeps the same 30/200 consumed budget and rejected families but still includes HL-vs-Binance/Bybit as a possible new-data route. Shows state evolution without reopening burned HL-dYdX history.

Critical continuity receipt: four Opus agents were killed by session limits before any commit, leaving nothing recoverable. Method changes immediately to at most two agents, frequent WIP branch pushes, explicit registry and checkpoint-before-wave. Direct evidence that ephemeral parallelism caused real lost work.

Fast Rail state after H003/H004/H005 rejects and H002 WIP. It preserves exact patches/restart commands and classifies degenerate high-t prediction-market result using binomial evidence rather than accepting the headline statistic. Good example of adversarial statistical correction plus restart-safe handoff.

Iteration-2 autonomous Fast Rail: forward/shadow focus, SHADOW_DIRECT, red-team fixes, H010 resumable scan, multiple REJECT/UNDERPOWERED/NON-ENTRY outcomes and automated feed collection. Explicitly shifts bottleneck from ideas to forward evidence and requires conservative declared sigma.
Resume variant after relaunching H006/H002 with WIP pushes and an hourly watchdog. It captures the transition from lost uncommitted subagent work to persistent WIP branches and scheduled resumption.

Fast Rail state with H001 still blocked and H003/H004/H005 rejected. Reinforces that prediction-market easy edges disappeared under validation and that high t with zero losses requires a binomial/asymmetry sanity check.

Early resume snapshot after four-agent loss; two-agent relaunch plus WIP branches and delayed watchdog. Useful evidence that continuity tooling was introduced reactively after session destruction, not present from the start.

H002 and H006 are now both REJECT, while H004 remains in progress. Dataset-level multiplicity is explicit: H002 validation uses 50 trials and is closed for historical reuse. Demonstrates scoped negative memory rather than endless retuning.

Rich unified Fast Rail snapshot records 31 consumed trials, multiple interrupted agents with preserved patches/index checkpoints, corrected pristine_after invariant, real feed scheduling and owner-secret dependencies. It distinguishes WIP interruption from scientific consumption and preserves exact recovery instructions.

Unified state before H010 completion: explicit power-first rule, forward-only routes, predeclared practitioner-study lanes and corrected pristine_after contamination. Also shows a critical operational dependency: scheduled feeds would not run until the workflow reached default branch.

Near-identical unified state but with conflicting ODDS_API_KEY status versus neighboring snapshots. This is a direct example that point-in-time operational facts in state files can go stale and must be bound to exact version/time rather than merged narratively.

Compact unified state preserves 30 consumed trials, forward-only lanes and corrected pristine_after law. Repeated versions show the stable scientific rule set amid changing feed/secret/workflow facts.

Iteration-2 state adds sequential-test sigma floor after red-team false-acceptance finding, autonomous recovery instructions, H010 resumability and explicit removal of SPAC/merger-arb by later owner order. Strong example of governance delta modifying search scope without erasing earlier evidence.
Earliest concise Fast Rail snapshot: 22 declared trials, four first-wave hypotheses and H001 blocked on Odds key. Provides baseline before later session-loss and checkpoint reforms.

Autonomous iteration-2 snapshot with H001 red-team active, H010 resumable indexing, SHADOW_DIRECT forward lane and multiple explicit NON-ENTRY/UNDERPOWERED outcomes. Shows mature ability to avoid spending trials when expected information is insufficient.

Unified state briefly considers Treasury-auction H009 and public crypto-funding sources while keeping consumed datasets closed. Useful for forgotten-path analysis: some candidates were parked because power/information value was insufficient, not because code was missing.

Unified state with scheduled feeds reported active but ODDS_API_KEY still absent. When compared with nearby versions that later report the key present, it demonstrates point-in-time operational-state churn and the danger of treating a state snapshot as timeless truth.

Resume state formalizes checkpoint script that saves every agent worktree as patches before long tasks, after earlier losses. H002 remains interrupted but recoverable via exact patch; H003/H004/H005 are closed negative results. Direct evidence of a practical anti-rework mechanism that should have existed before parallel execution.

cross_object_findings.finding: DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE simultaneously contains valuable corrections of lookahead artifacts and an unsupported jump to production-ready/live-deployment language. This is a clean example of why later proof-domain/authority distinctions were necessary.

Four Opus agents exhausted a session in under an hour before any commit, leaving no recoverable work. Fast Rail then imposed <=2 agents, WIP branch pushes, checkpoint scripts and exact restart instructions. This is primary documentary evidence that uncontrolled parallelism created direct rework.

Two builders operating on the same dataset consumed overlapping historical evidence, leading Fast Rail to declare that dataset burned and adopt one-builder-per-dataset plus power-before-test. Coordination failure therefore damaged not only engineering productivity but scientific optionality.

Later versions classify candidates as UNDERPOWERED/NON-ENTRY before consuming trials, close burned datasets to historical reruns, preserve forward-only reopening conditions and distinguish blocked access from scientific rejection. This is a strong positive method to preserve.

Neighboring FAST_RAIL_STATE versions disagree about secrets/feed activation while sharing the same scientific core. These are legitimate temporal state changes but prove why state snapshots require exact-version/time binding and cannot be merged into one timeless narrative.
Bundle 0005 provides strong causal evidence about overpromotion, lost parallel work and scientific-budget discipline but reveals no new current canonical code/runtime repair requirement.
